gloss_en: the worm (tolaʿ) of holiness — the humble self-effacement of 'I am a worm and not a man' (Ps. 22:7), identified as the aspect of faith (per 'ha-emunim alei tolaʿ', Lam. 4:5), of Abraham, and of chesed-within-gevurah / the olat tamid, which subdues the worm of the kelipah; not any literal insect or the scarlet dye as mere material
